headline: BNR foreign exchange reserves rose in August to EUR 64.865 billion
summary: The National Bank of Romania reported foreign exchange reserves of EUR 64.865 billion as of 31 August 2026, up EUR 1.635 billion from end-July. The increase is a monthly gain in the central bank's reserve buffer.
why: Central bank foreign exchange reserves are a key indicator of a country's capacity to defend its currency and meet external obligations.
